<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;
int read(){
	char c=getchar();
	int sum=0;
	while(!isdigit(c))c=getchar();
	while(isdigit(c))sum=sum*10+c-'0',c=getchar();
	return sum;
}
string s;
char t[105];
int pos=1;
bool flag;
int main(){
	ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
	cin.tie(0);
	cin>>s;
	t[0]=s[0];
	int sz=s.size();
	s+=string(4, '\0');
	for(int i=1;i<sz;){
		if(s[i]=='d'&&s[i+1]=='o'&&s[i+2]=='t'&&s[i+3]!='\0'){
			t[pos++]='.';
			i+=3;
			continue;
		}
		if(s[i]=='a'&&s[i+1]=='t'&&flag==false){
			t[pos++]='@';
			flag=true;
			i+=2;
			continue;
		}
		t[pos++]=s[i];
		i++;
	}
	t[pos]='\0';
	printf("%s",t);
	return 0;
}
